verdict.rationale: Visa Intelligent Commerce is a payments API platform that provides tokens, passkey-anchored mandates, the Trusted Agent Protocol, and an MCP server and agent toolkit so that third-party agents can transact. A built-in assistant is a plausible feature for a developer platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack shows a first-party AI assistant inside the product that users can delegate tasks to. The toolkit's plain-language claim describes working with external AI agents, which is a developer building block rather than a built-in assistant, so it earns no credit.
